title: Allegory, Liberty Seated — Selo definitivo da República Argentina
creator: Correos de la República Argentina
description: Figura feminina de Liberty sentada, braço esquerdo apoiado em escudo com brasão argentino, sol nascente sobre o oceano ao fundo. Série definitiva de 22 selos. Tiragem do 1c verde: 70.920.000.

title: Zeichnet 8. Kriegsanleihe
creator: R.K. (monogramado, não identificado)
description: Figura feminina clássica segura espada numa mão e balança na outra. De um lado da balança, uma pomba da paz (mais pesada); do outro, moedas. Alegoria de que a paz supera o dinheiro, mas dinheiro é necessário para alcançá-la. Publicado em Viena.

title: Allégorie de la Justice (Joseph Stallaert, Brussels City Hall)
creator: Joseph Stallaert
description: Allegorical painting of Justice in the Mayor's Cabinet of Brussels City Hall, by Joseph Stallaert. Part of a triptych with Charity and Foresight — three female allegorical virtues required of a mayor. Justice symbolized by scales and sword. A Belgian civic example connecting female virtue to politic

title: 5 Francs — Léopold I (founding coin of Belgium)
description: AUSENCIA ALEGORICA — portrait of Léopold I

title: 100 Francs Banque du Congo Belge — Allegory of Europe Kneeling with African Boys
creator: Banque du Congo Belge
description: European woman kneeling, holding fabric. Two African boys — one seated, one standing holding medallion with profile of crowned European woman. Elephant tusks and exotic fruits on the ground. Paternalistic colonial imagery: the European woman 'civilizes' through textile/clothing. The medallion create

title: Monument aux Pionniers Belges au Congo — La Race Noire Accueillie par la Belgique
creator: Thomas Vinçotte
description: La Belgique seated, holding torch, lifting veil for a semi-nude African woman presenting her children. The European allegory is clothed, static, authoritative; the African woman is semi-nude, subordinate. Racialized ENDURECIMENTO: white woman hardened/dressed vs. Black woman exposed/submitted. Vinço

title: 5 Francs — 50 ans de Belgique: La Belgique avec Constitution et Lion
creator: Charles Wiener (engraver)
description: Commemorative coin for 50th anniversary of Belgian independence. Reverse: personification of Belgium leaning on lion, holding Belgian Constitution. Congress Column to left, Brussels Palace of Justice to right. Obverse: jugate busts of Leopold I and Leopold II.

title: 20 Francs Belgian Congo — Allegory of Europe with Mace and African Woman with Ivory Tusk
creator: Banque du Congo Belge
description: Woman as allegory of Europe/Belgium holding mace placed on anvil. African woman at her side holding elephant ivory tusk. Explicit colonial visual hierarchy: white allegorical figure clothed and armed, African figure offering colonial wealth.

title: Alegoria da República (Carlos Chambelland)
creator: Carlos Chambelland
description: Allegorical painting commissioned for Brazil's centennial of independence (1922). Female figure in flowing white and green robes, arm raised, accompanied by an angel, with male figures holding manuscripts below — blending republican allegory with national celebration.

title: As Estátuas Fallando (The Statues Speaking) — Justiça
creator: Unknown (periodical 'BRASIL')
description: Article titled 'As Estátuas Fallando' (The Statues Speaking) featuring a literary dialogue where Justice appears as an animated statue character. 'A Verdade: Que dizes, ó Justiça?' (Truth: What do you say, oh Justice?). Early Brazilian example of Justice personified as a speaking female figure in pe

title: Estátua da Justiça (Luiz Rochet) — referência no Almanak Laemmert
creator: Luiz Rochet (sculptor); Almanak Laemmert (source)
description: Reference in the Almanak Laemmert (1929 edition) to the statue of Justice by French sculptor Luiz Rochet, inaugurated September 1872. Alongside statues of History, Poetry and Science. Documents the importation of French allegorical sculpture into Brazilian public space.

title: A Justiça (Alfredo Ceschiatti, STF Brasília)
creator: Alfredo Ceschiatti
description: Monumental granite sculpture of Justice (Themis) seated before the Supreme Federal Tribunal in Brasília. Eyes closed, holding a sword with both hands. Designed to complement Oscar Niemeyer's modernist architecture. The Brazilian Justiça — a seated, blindfolded, sword-bearing woman as the face of the

title: Eliseu Visconti — Alegoria (Biblioteca Nacional, Rio de Janeiro)
creator: Eliseu Visconti
description: Impressionist-style allegorical panel for the Presidential Room of the Biblioteca Nacional in Rio de Janeiro. Female allegorical figure in Visconti's distinctive impressionist idiom — the French-trained Brazilian artist adapting European allegorical vocabulary to national institutional decoration. A

title: 1000 Réis — Efígie da República (Brasil, 1906–1912)
description: A República

title: 1 Cruzeiro (cédula) — Efígie da República (2ª edição)
description: A República (efígie em medalha)

title: 2000 Réis — Efígie da República com Barrete Frígio
creator: Casa da Moeda do Brasil
description: Bust of the Republic wearing Phrygian cap, profile facing left. Inscription: REPUBLICA DOS ESTADOS UNIDOS DO BRAZIL. Reverse: denomination and date within wreath. Positivist Republic period. Transplant of French Marianne Pathosformel to Brazilian context.

title: 50 Cruzeiros — Efígie da República (Benedito Ribeiro / Tônia Carreiro)
description: A República (efígie)

title: Germania
creator: Friedrich August von Kaulbach
description: Personificação da Alemanha como mulher guerreira (Germania), pintada por Friedrich August von Kaulbach em agosto de 1914, no início da Primeira Guerra Mundial. A figura feminina erguida aparece com coroa imperial de estilo otoniano, espada desembainhada, escudo heráldico e couraça feminina, em fundo

title: Helft uns siegen! Zeichnet die Kriegsanleihe
creator: Fritz Erler
description: Um dos cartazes de empréstimo de guerra alemães mais icônicos. Parte da série Kriegsanleihe que financiou o esforço bélico alemão. A campanha empregou sistematicamente figuras alegóricas femininas da Vitória e da Pátria.

title: Germania — Guter Rat ist teuer (Bismarck e Alsácia-Lorena)
creator: Wilhelm Scholz
description: Cartoon satírico do Kladderadatsch: Bismarck conduz as figuras femininas alegóricas de Alsácia e Lorena — jovens em trajes regionais — para o Império Alemão. Germania preside a absorção territorial.

title: 1000 Mark Reichsbanknote — allegorical figures
description: Germania / Navigation / Agriculture

title: 100 Mark Reichsbanknote — Germania seated (green seals)
description: Germania

title: 50 Mark Reichsbanknote (24 Jun. 1919) — última cédula imperial / primeira Weimar
description: Allegorical female figure (transitional)

title: 50 Mark Reichsbanknote — Germania as Young Girl (Weimar 1919)
creator: Reichsdruckerei

title: 50 Reichspfennig — Woman Planting Oak Sapling (Weimar 1924)
creator: Richard Martin Werner

title: Germania — Reichspost / Deutsches Reich Definitive Stamp (Paul Eduard Waldraff)
creator: Paul Eduard Waldraff (designer), Anna Führing (model)
description: Bust of Germania wearing octagonal imperial crown, holding sword and olive branch. Art Nouveau design personally chosen by Kaiser Wilhelm II. Model: actress Anna Führing. Longest-running German definitive series (22 years). NOT used in colonies (replaced by Yacht issue). Overprinted for occupied ter

title: Germania "Belgien" Overprint — Military Occupation Stamp (WWI)
creator: Paul Eduard Waldraff (original design)
description: Germania definitive stamp overprinted with "Belgien" and revalued in Centimes/Francs for use in German-occupied Belgium during WWI. Same image as DE-GERM-1900 but with additional state inscription marking occupation. First series October 1914, second series May 1916.

title: 5 Pesetas "Hispania Reclinada" — Gobierno Provisional
creator: Gobierno Provisional de España
description: Hispania reclinada coroada com coroa mural, apoiada nos Pireneus com Gibraltar a seus pés, segurando ramo de oliveira. Mar e raios de sol ao fundo. Moeda fundacional da Espanha pós-monárquica, cunhada apenas durante o breve Gobierno Provisional.

title: 1 Peseta "Hispania Sentada" — II República
creator: José Eusebio Espinós Gisbert
description: Hispania sentada sobre plinto, segurando ramo de oliveira. Última peseta de prata jamais cunhada. A continuidade da pose sentada de 1870 a 1933 revela a *Nachleben* da mesma *Pathosformel* através de duas rupturas fundacionais distintas.

title: La Justice, la Vengeance et la Vérité
creator: François-Nicolas Chifflart
description: Engraving depicting three female allegorical figures: Justice, Vengeance, and Truth. A powerful composition showing Justice as a dominant female presence, flanked by Truth and divine Vengeance — key triad in French republican allegorical vocabulary.

title: Le triomphe de la Justice et de la Vérité
creator: François-Nicolas Chifflart
description: Engraving showing the triumph of Justice and Truth as female allegorical figures. Complete state with full lettering. Part of Chifflart's series on juridical allegory.

title: L'envoyé de la Justice
creator: François-Nicolas Chifflart
description: Engraving titled 'The Envoy of Justice' — depicting a figure sent by Justice (as a female allegorical power). Early example in the series of Justice representations by Chifflart.

title: Marianne enseignant l'alphabet à des enfants (naïades et Marianne)
creator: Unknown
description: Engravings depicting naiads and Marianne teaching the alphabet to children. Powerful image of the Republic-as-woman as educator — embodying the republican ideal of laïcité and public instruction through a female allegorical figure.

title: La République aimable (Félicien Rops)
creator: Félicien Rops
description: Satirical engraving by Belgian-French artist Félicien Rops depicting 'The Amiable Republic' — a subversive or eroticized representation of the Republic as a woman. Critical for understanding the contested gendered nature of republican allegory and its use in satirical press.

title: The French Crisis: Madame La République
creator: Unknown
description: Political cartoon from 1887 showing 'Madame La République' during the French political crisis. The Republic personified as a woman under stress — a key document of how female allegory was deployed during political instability.

title: La République nous appelle... (Steinlen)
creator: Théophile Alexandre Steinlen (1859–1923)
description: WWI recruitment poster: 'The Republic calls us...' — Marianne as a summoning female figure, calling citizens to arms. Steinlen's powerful composition shows the Republic-as-woman as a quasi-maternal/military figure demanding sacrifice.

title: Buste de la République (Agence Rol)
creator: Agence Rol (photographic agency)
description: Press photograph of a bust sculpture representing the French Republic. Busts of Marianne became ubiquitous in French town halls (mairies) under the Third Republic — the multiplication of the female allegorical form across thousands of civic spaces.

title: Le hochet de la République (Jean Veber)
creator: Jean Veber (1868–1928)
description: Satirical print 'The Rattle of the Republic' by Jean Veber. The Republic as a woman reduced to a toy or rattle — a critical/ironic commentary on the infantilization or trivialization of republican symbolism through its female form.

title: Madame Anastasie (avec les ciseaux de la censure)
creator: André Gill
description: Capa de L'Éclipse no. 209: velha quase surda e cega agarrando tesouras enormes — personificação da censura da imprensa. Encarna o aparato repressivo do governo da Ordem Moral sob MacMahon. A "Anastasie" de Gill tornou-se a representação icônica francesa da censura.

title: La Paix — Idylle
creator: Honoré Daumier
description: Litografia da série Actualités: paisagem devastada de ruínas após a Guerra Franco-Prussiana. O título irônico "Paz — Idílio" transforma o gênero pastoral/feminino do idílio em cena de destruição total.

title: L'Empire c'est la paix
creator: Honoré Daumier
description: Litografia da série Actualités: campo de ruínas e ossos com inscrição sarcástica citando o motto inaugural de Napoleão III. A figura feminina alegórica da França/Paz está conspicuamente ausente da paisagem devastada.

title: 5 Francs (Cérès, 2e République)
description: Cérès / La République

title: Semeuse 1 Franc silver coin (Oscar Roty)
creator: Louis Oscar Roty

title: Piastre de Commerce — Marianne Assise avec Fasces
creator: Jean-Auguste Barre (designer)
description: Marianne seated left on throne holding fasces, wearing radiate crown. Wheat bundles to left, anchor to right. Reverse: INDO-CHINE FRANÇAISE. Colonial trade coin for Indochina.

title: 5 Francs Hercule — La République et La Justice flanquant Hercule
creator: Augustin Dupré (designer, original 1795)
description: Hercules standing center flanked by two female allegories: Republic (left, with pike topped by Phrygian cap) and Justice/Equality (right, with triangular level). Design by Dupré (1795), reissued 1848 and 1870. Banned during Second Empire for republican symbols.

title: Semeuse — Selo Definitivo da República Francesa (Oscar Roty / Mouchon)
creator: Louis-Oscar Roty (original design), Louis-Eugène Mouchon (stamp adaptation)
description: Marianne in flowing robes and Phrygian cap sowing seeds with extended right arm, seed bag under left arm. Rising sun on horizon (1903 version). Design from Roty medal (1887), adapted for coin (1897) then stamp (1903). Quintessential NORMATIVE Marianne: peaceful, productive, nurturing.

title: Sottoscrivete al Prestito — Italia Turrita
creator: Giovanni Capranesi
description: Italia Turrita com coroa mural, armadura e tricolor italiano, segurando espada apontada contra guerreiro nórdico/germânico avançando sobre montanhas. Publicado em Bérgamo pelo Istituto Italiano d'Arti Grafiche.

title: 100 Lire "Minerva" — Testa d'Italia laureata
creator: Giuseppe Romagnoli / Pietro Giampaoli
description: Anverso: cabeça feminina da Italia coroada de louros, virada à esquerda, inspirada em moedas siracusanas (séc. IV a.C.). Reverso: Minerva de pé com lança e loureiro. A Italia laureada é variante secularizada da Italia Turrita.

title: 500 Lire "Caravelle" — Italia Turrita
creator: Guido Veroi
description: Anverso: busto de mulher renascentista com coroa mural (Italia Turrita), cercada por 19 brasões de capitais regionais. Reverso: três caravelas. Inscrição: REPVBBLICA ITALIANA. 97,8M de exemplares.

title: Selo "Siracusana" — Italia Turrita
creator: Vittorio Grassi
description: Série definitiva mais longeva da República Italiana. Cabeça feminina com coroa de torres e muralhas (corona muralis), inspirada em moeda da antiga Siracusa. Emitida em múltiplas denominações.

title: Alegoría de la República Mexicana con Símbolos Masónicos
creator: Primitivo Miranda
medium: Aquarela sobre marfim em moldura circular de madeira laqueada
description: Miniatura em aquarela sobre marfim. República Mexicana personificada como mulher de azul com bordados dourados, cocar de plumas e coroa de ouro, segurando malho. Acima, triângulo radiante com olho (símbolo maçônico). Primeiro plano: águia com serpente, âncora, compasso, esquadro. Acervo do Museo Nac

title: 1 Escudo "Alvorada" — Primeira República Portuguesa
creator: Francisco dos Santos (anverso) / José Simões de Almeida Sobrinho (reverso)
description: Figura feminina da República com barrete frígio, agitando tocha acesa, bandeira portuguesa no braço e sol nascente ao fundo. Inscrição: 5 DE OUTUBRO DE 1910. A "Alvorada" é a Marianne portuguesa: importação explícita da gramática visual republicana francesa adaptada à mitologia fundacional lusófona.

title: Série Ceres — Selo definitivo da República Portuguesa
creator: Constantino de Sobral Fernandes (design) / José Sérgio de Carvalho e Silva (gravura)
description: Primeira série definitiva de selos após a proclamação da República, substituindo selos com retrato de D. Manuel II. Deusa romana Ceres de pé, segurando foice e feixe de trigo. A escolha de Ceres (abundância agrícola) sobre figura marcial reflete a narrativa republicana de soberania popular enraizada

title: Women of Britain Say 'Go!'
creator: Ernest James Kealey
description: British WWI recruitment poster by E.J. Kealey (1915), published by the Parliamentary Recruiting Committee (Poster No. 75). Shows two women and a boy at an open window watching soldiers march away. The female figures embody a gendered allegory of domestic Britain urging men to enlist — deploying the

title: Take Up the Sword of Justice
creator: Bernard Partridge
description: Figura feminina de corpo inteiro personificando a Justiça ergue-se sobre o mar, estendendo espada embainhada. Abaixo, figuras afogando-se; ao fundo, o RMS Lusitania afundando. Parliamentary Recruiting Committee Poster No. 111.

title: Two Forces — Britannia protecting Hibernia
creator: John Tenniel
description: Britannia armada e imperial como "irmã mais velha" protegendo uma Hibernia bela e indefesa de figuras Fenian monstruosas. Britannia é militarizada; Hibernia é infantilizada e passiva. Duas alegorias femininas DIFERENTES mobilizadas uma contra a outra.

title: 1 Florin — Britannia Standing on Ship Prow (Edward VII)
description: Britannia

title: 1 Penny — Britannia Seated, Helmeted (George V, 1912)
description: Britannia

title: British Trade Dollar — Britannia Standing with Trident and Shield
creator: George William De Saulles (designer)
description: Britannia standing on shore holding trident and shield with Union Flag, merchant ship in background. Reverse with denomination in Chinese and Jawi Malay. Colonial trade dollar for circulation in Hong Kong, Straits Settlements, Labuan. Minted in Bombay and Calcutta.

title: Penny — Britannia Seated with Trident, Helmet and Shield
creator: Leonard Charles Wyon (designer)
description: Britannia seated right on rock, wearing helmet and breastplate with flowing dress, holding trident, right hand resting on shield with Union Flag. Lighthouse to left, ship to right (pre-1895). Most widely circulated allegory in the British Empire.

title: Hedwig Reicher as Columbia in suffrage pageant
creator: Unknown (photograph)
description: German actress Hedwig Reicher in costume as 'Columbia' at a suffrage pageant where Columbia summoned Justice, Charity, Liberty, Peace, and Hope to revive the crusade of women. A feminist reappropriation of national female allegory — Columbia mobilized for women's suffrage.

title: The Goddess of Liberty (woman in star-spangled cape)
creator: Unknown
description: Photograph of a woman model in Liberty costume with stars, representing Liberty/Columbia during the Civil War era. The living body performing the allegory — a real woman embodying the national feminine symbol.

title: Temple of Liberty
creator: Jared W. Bell
description: Woodcut broadside by Jared W. Bell (1834) depicting the Temple of Liberty as an allegorical female figure — the Goddess of Liberty — enthroned or standing within a classical temple. A key example of antebellum American female allegorical imagery deploying classical architecture and female personific

title: Wake up America! Civilization calls every man, woman and child!
creator: James Montgomery Flagg
description: WWI recruitment poster by James Montgomery Flagg (1917) depicting Columbia — the female personification of America — sleeping, dressed in patriotic stars and stripes and wearing a Phrygian cap. The figure of Columbia, modeled on actress Mary Arthur, embodies the nation's allegorical identity. One of

title: Columbia calls—Enlist now for U.S. Army
creator: Frances Adams Halsted (des.); Vincente Aderente (painted)
description: WWI recruitment poster (1917) depicting Columbia standing on the globe atop North America, holding the American flag and a sword, calling men to enlist. Designed by Frances Adams Halsted (who also wrote the accompanying poem) and painted by Vincente Aderente. After the U.S. entered WWI on April 6, 1

title: Wake Up America! Civilization Calls Every Man, Woman and Child!
creator: James Montgomery Flagg
description: Columbia adormecida contra coluna fluted, vestindo manto de stars-and-stripes e barrete frígio. Nuvens de tempestade ao fundo. Atriz Mary Arthur serviu de modelo. Impresso para o "Wake Up America Day" de 19 de abril de 1917.

title: Columbia Calls — Enlist Now for U.S. Army
creator: Frances Adams Halsted (design) / Vincent Aderente (pintura)
description: Columbia sobre globo terrestre, posicionada na América do Norte, segurando bandeira americana e espada. 500.000 cópias impressas pelo U.S. War Department.

title: Fight or Buy Bonds — Third Liberty Loan
creator: Howard Chandler Christy
description: Mulher de branco encarnando Liberty agita a bandeira americana enquanto soldados marcham atrás. A "Christy Girl" funde feminilidade idealizada com propósito marcial.

title: Liberty Is Not Anarchy
creator: Thomas Nast
description: Mãos desincorporadas de Columbia/Liberty agarrando anarquistas numa mão e espada "U.S." na outra, após o veredito de Haymarket. Columbia é reduzida a enormes mãos punitivas — sem rosto, sem corpo, apenas instrumentos de violência estatal.

title: Looking Backward
creator: Joseph Keppler
description: Litografia colorida: americanos ricos — eles mesmos imigrantes ou filhos de imigrantes — bloqueiam um recém-chegado da Europa Oriental. Suas sombras na parede revelam origens humildes. Columbia está conspicuamente ausente da cena onde deveria aparecer como mãe acolhedora.

title: 1 Dollar Silver Certificate 'Educational Series' — History Instructing Youth
description: History / Columbia (instructing Youth)

title: Science Presenting Steam and Electricity to Commerce and Manufacture ($2 Silver Certificate)
creator: Edwin Howland Blashfield (artist), George F.C. Smillie (engraver)

title: Electricity Presenting Light to the World ($5 Silver Certificate)
creator: Walter Shirlaw (artist), George F.C. Smillie (engraver)

title: 1 Dollar 'Seated Liberty' (without motto)
description: Liberty (Seated)

title: Standing Liberty Quarter — Liberty with Shield and Olive Branch
creator: Hermon Atkins MacNeil (designer)
description: Liberty standing, holding shield in left hand and olive branch in right, advancing through open gate. Type I (1916-1917): bare breast exposed. Type II (1917-1930): chain mail covers breast after public controversy. Documentes ENDURECIMENTO in real time.
